threat_event: Counterfeit or tampered network or video equipment bought from a broker enters inventory and ships to a DoD or commercial customer
threat_source: Counterfeiters and dishonest brokers in the gray market
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 12 brokers never assessed; receiving checks quantities only (no serial, seal, or firmware checks); sourcing order not written
existing_controls: Buyers prefer authorized sources; approved supplier list
treatment_plan: C-SCRM plan with written sourcing order; authorized sources only for DoD jobs now; broker assessments; receiving inspection with OEM serial validation; quarantine for broker stock

threat_event: Covered telecommunications or video surveillance equipment (FAR 52.204-25) is delivered on a federal order
threat_source: Data gaps and human error in purchasing and order entry; supplier misrepresentation
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 1,260 SKUs (9%) have no manufacturer of record; manual name checks only when a prime asks; no hard block on federal orders
existing_controls: Manual check by the Government Contracts Manager on request
treatment_plan: Make manufacturer of record mandatory; covered-manufacturer screening list with a hard block on federal orders; broker attestations; reporting procedure (P08)

threat_event: Supplier email compromise leads to a fraudulent bank-detail change and a diverted supplier payment
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Bank-detail changes accepted by email with no call-back; near miss of $86,000 on 2026-05-12
existing_controls: Controller alone can change supplier bank details in the ERP; bank fraud screening caught the near miss
treatment_plan: Call-back to a known number before any bank-detail change; second approver for changes; payment hold of 5 business days after a change; BEC training

threat_event: CUI configuration documents are disclosed from the open general file share or ERP attachments
threat_source: Malicious insider or external attacker using any employee account
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: About 140 CUI documents readable by all 62 users; 14 ERP orders with CUI attachments in a SaaS without FedRAMP equivalency; no MFA on the file share
existing_controls: Named accounts; MFA for remote access; firewall
treatment_plan: CUI enclave project: restricted CUI share for 9 users with MFA; purge ERP CUI attachments and block new ones; lab VLAN

threat_event: The company cannot show SP 800-171 Rev. 2 compliance or the CMMC status Prime B requires in time and loses the Prime B option period from 2027-04-01
threat_source: Gaps too large for the time and budget available
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 2026 self-score of -84 of 110; many 5-point requirements unmet; part-time security staff
existing_controls: This gap analysis and POA&M; $118,000 budget approved
treatment_plan: Monthly POA&M review by the Chief Operating Officer; close all 5-point and non-POA&M-eligible requirements first; keep the voluntary C3PAO assessment in 2027-02 (Prime B's Level 2 (C3PAO) requirement is suspended with CMMC Phase 2; SP 800-171 Rev. 2 under 252.204-7012 still applies); external consultant hours

threat_event: SPRS score and CMMC Level 1 affirmation found unsupported, leading to contract remedies or False Claims Act exposure
threat_source: Government or prime review of posted scores and affirmations
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 2024 score of 96 and 2026 Level 1 affirmation entered without documented assessments
treatment_plan: On counsel's advice, post a corrected Basic Assessment and correct the Level 1 entry; document every future assessment

threat_event: Ransomware delivered by phishing encrypts WMS servers, the file server, and endpoints and deletes backups
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No 24x7 monitoring; backups in the same account; flat network; annual awareness video only
treatment_plan: Managed detection and response with 24x7 alerting; immutable backups in a separate account; lab and server segmentation; quarterly phishing exercises

threat_event: WMS and file server backups cannot be restored when needed
threat_source: Backup failure or deletion by an attacker with cloud administrator rights
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Backups share the production account and roles; never restore-tested; nightly schedule gives a 24 h RPO against a 4 h target
existing_controls: Nightly backups to a backup vault
treatment_plan: Separate backup account with immutable retention; 4-hourly WMS database backups; quarterly restore tests; recovery procedures

threat_event: Tampered firmware or an implant in configured equipment reaches a DoD installation network
threat_source: Nation-state actor targeting the defense supply chain
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No firmware hash or signature checks in the lab; no tamper inspection at receiving; broker stock can reach the lab
existing_controls: Firmware downloaded only from OEM portals
treatment_plan: Authorized-source stock only for Prime B; verify firmware hashes and signatures; seal and packaging inspection; record serials per job

threat_event: Compromise of the MSP remote monitoring and management tool gives an attacker administrator access to every endpoint and server
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: RMM agent on all Windows devices; sessions not approved or timed out; no customer responsibility matrix
treatment_plan: Customer responsibility matrix; session approval and timeouts; restrict RMM to approved source addresses; annual MSP security review

threat_event: Inventory adjustments under shared WMS accounts hide theft or errors
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 6 shared zone accounts on handhelds; no MFA; adjustments cannot be tied to a person
treatment_plan: Named WMS accounts with individual PINs now; identity provider sign-in when handhelds are replaced

threat_event: An attacker exploits the unsupported handheld operating system through warehouse Wi-Fi
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Handheld operating system past vendor support; scanner Wi-Fi uses one shared key
existing_controls: Scanner Wi-Fi on its own SSID
treatment_plan: Isolate handhelds on a scanner VLAN that reaches only the WMS; replace all 40 handhelds

threat_event: Product theft at the dock by unescorted drivers or visitors
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Drivers and visitors enter the dock without escort; badge logs kept 30 days
treatment_plan: Driver waiting area and escort rule; 1-year badge log retention; electronic visitor log

threat_event: An unauthorized person views or takes CUI printouts or devices from the configuration lab
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: CUI printouts leave the cage for the office printer; lab key not logged
treatment_plan: Printer inside the cage; locked cabinet; rekey and key log; clean-desk rule

threat_event: A single-source supplier fails, cutting off the ruggedized switch or encrypted video line
threat_source: Supplier business failure, allocation, or compromise
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Two critical product lines each have one source (one authorized distributor; one OEM program)
treatment_plan: Qualify a second authorized source for each line; safety stock of 30 days for Prime B items; criticality analysis in the C-SCRM plan

threat_event: An ERP SaaS outage stops order capture and invoicing for more than a shipping day
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Contract states 99.9% availability but no RTO or RPO; no tested downtime procedure
treatment_plan: Order-log downtime procedure; recovery terms at renewal; review vendor SOC 2 availability section

threat_event: Reseller portal account takeover leads to fraudulent orders shipped to attacker addresses
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: MFA optional for about 1,100 reseller users; ship-to changes not verified
treatment_plan: Require MFA for all reseller users; hold orders to new ship-to addresses for verification

threat_event: The portal sync exposes DoD order data to the reseller portal, pulling the portal into CUI and FCI scope
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: ERP-to-portal sync rules not confirmed to exclude DoD orders
treatment_plan: Confirm and document the sync filter; test with a DoD order

threat_event: A cyber incident affecting CUI is not reported to DoD within 72 hours
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No DoD-approved medium assurance certificate; no incident response plan until 2026-08-31
treatment_plan: Obtain the certificate; reporting procedure and contact list in P08; tabletop exercise

threat_event: Logs needed for an investigation or DoD request have rolled over
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Cloud logs kept 90 days, identity logs 30 days, badge logs 30 days
treatment_plan: Central log store with 1-year retention that administrators cannot delete

threat_event: An intrusion goes undetected for weeks
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No log review; no alert monitoring; no correlation
treatment_plan: Managed detection and response with 24x7 alerting; weekly sign-in review

threat_event: A known vulnerability in the firewall, VPN, or servers is exploited
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No vulnerability scanning; no firmware update schedule
existing_controls: Monthly server patching by the MSP
treatment_plan: Monthly authenticated scans; remediation timelines by severity; quarterly firmware updates

threat_event: Malware or CUI leakage through internet access or USB storage on lab workstations
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Lab workstations have open internet access, unrestricted USB storage, and local administrator rights
treatment_plan: Block USB storage except issued encrypted drives; outbound allow list; remove local administrator rights

threat_event: An attacker moves from the corporate or guest network to the lab and the CUI share
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Lab bench network on the flat corporate VLAN; outbound not deny-by-default
treatment_plan: Lab VLAN with deny-by-default rules; management VLAN

threat_event: Staff fall for phishing, pretexting, or fake supplier calls
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Annual awareness video only; no phishing exercises or role-based training
treatment_plan: Quarterly modules on BEC, CUI, and supplier fraud; phishing exercises; role-based training

threat_event: Forecasting errors cause overstock or stockouts on key lines
threat_source: Model error, data drift, or bad input data
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Pilot model not validated by product line; buyers accept most suggestions
treatment_plan: Monthly accuracy and bias metrics by product line and customer segment (P10); override logging

threat_event: Automated reordering creates purchase orders with brokers or covered manufacturers without review
threat_source: Tool configuration that ranks suppliers by price and availability
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Suggested orders include broker sources; no link to the approved supplier list or Section 889 screening
treatment_plan: Keep auto-release off; restrict suggestions to approved authorized sources; hard block covered manufacturers (P10)

threat_event: Staff paste CUI, customer pricing, or supplier data into public generative AI tools
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No approved-tools list before POL-05 (2026-08-31); no blocking of public AI sites
treatment_plan: Approved-tools list; block unapproved AI sites on lab workstations; training (P10 AI-002)

threat_event: The forecasting vendor mishandles DoD order history (FCI)
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Full order history including DoD orders sent under vendor terms with no FAR 52.204-21 safeguards
existing_controls: None beyond the vendor standard terms
treatment_plan: Filter DoD orders out of the feed; add security terms at renewal

threat_event: Loss of the IT Manager, Systems Administrator, or Government Contracts Manager stalls the CMMC program and reporting
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Two-person IT team; one person knows the DIBNet, SPRS, and Section 889 processes
treatment_plan: Written procedures; cross-train the Controller as backup for SPRS and DIBNet; consultant retainer

threat_event: EDI network outage or misrouted transactions delay supplier and customer orders
threat_source: EDI network provider failure or mapping error
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No monitoring of failed EDI transactions
treatment_plan: Accept: partners resend and email fallback exists; review at renewal

threat_event: A departed employee keeps access to email or the ERP
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Manual termination process, usually within about 3 business days; no lab exit checklist
existing_controls: HR emails IT on the last day
treatment_plan: Same-day disable from HR ticket; lab exit checklist

threat_event: A hurricane or long power loss closes the building for several days
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: One building; no alternate site; single ISP
existing_controls: SaaS ERP and portal reachable from anywhere; insurance
treatment_plan: Drop-ship arrangements with the 3 largest authorized distributors; cellular failover; hurricane checklist

threat_event: The shipping label service is unavailable at carrier cutoff
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Single label service
treatment_plan: Accept: carrier web portals are a working fallback

threat_event: A broker supplies rebranded (white-label) video surveillance products whose true manufacturer is a covered manufacturer
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 3 IP camera and video recorder SKUs from one broker have a blank OEM of record and match rebranded units of a manufacturer named in FAR 52.204-25
treatment_plan: Block the 3 SKUs on all orders; quarantine stock; suspend the broker pending review; screen all broker SKUs for white-label products
